title: Purchasing Officer
description:
Purchasing Officer
Global Constructions Ltd
has a reputable history of over 30 years in the Civil Construction industry in Papua New Guinea.
We are currently seeking to recruit a
Purchasing Officer
Major responsibilities include:
Daily administration of company’s Purchasing activities.
Perform Purchasing/Ordering Functions.
Chasing quotes on Constructions Products and workshop Parts.
Liaising with external suppliers
Provides routine office support.
Competencies and requirements:
Minimum of Year 12 HS Certificate.
Relevant Training or certification in Purchasing administration.
5 years previous working experience in a similar role.
Proficient computer skills in MS Word/Excel/Outlook.
Excellent communication skills, written and spoken
Excellent interpersonal & customer service skills
Must be Port Moresby based.
Good working habits
Current Driver license is required.
To apply please forward your resume to:
Human Resource
Global Constructions Ltd
P O Box 1453, Boroko, NCD
Or email:
[email protected]
Apply on or before COB  Friday 14
th
November  2025
